product.name: Confidential Computing Platform
product.description: A confidential computing platform and control plane that protects data, AI models, and secrets while they are in use across cloud and on-premises environments.
product.positioning: An enterprise-ready, multi-cloud confidential computing platform that goes beyond infrastructure access by providing policy-driven control, attestation verification, and secure key release for trusted execution environments.

features_and_capabilities.name: Trusted execution environment protection
features_and_capabilities.description: Protects data and workloads while they are being processed by isolating critical processes inside secure enclaves.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Uses secure enclaves and trusted execution environments to keep data encrypted at runtime and isolate workloads from the OS, hypervisor, and privileged operators.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Keeps sensitive data protected during use, including against insider and cloud operator access.

features_and_capabilities.name: Unified control plane
features_and_capabilities.description: Provides centralized management for confidential computing infrastructure and workflows.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Lets teams provision, configure, attest, and monitor their confidential computing stack from one place.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Reduces fragmented tooling and management complexity while maintaining control at scale.

features_and_capabilities.name: Attestation-based key release
features_and_capabilities.description: Verifies the integrity of the runtime environment before releasing keys.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Uses cryptographic attestation and policy enforcement so keys are released only when workloads run in trusted environments.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Prevents unauthorized environments and privileged users from accessing protected data or model weights.

features_and_capabilities.name: Multi-cloud and on-prem deployment
features_and_capabilities.description: Supports confidential computing across cloud providers and on-premises environments.
features_and_capabilities.how_it_works: Allows customers to enroll computing resources in the cloud or on-premises and deploy existing applications within a secure TEE.
features_and_capabilities.customer_benefit: Gives organizations flexibility to protect sensitive workloads without being tied to one cloud or needing major application rewrites.

differentiators: Acts as the control plane for confidential computing across clouds and environments rather than only providing infrastructure access.
Provides policy enforcement, attestation verification, and secure key release so workloads run only in trusted environments.
Offers an enterprise-ready platform designed to protect data, AI models, and secrets while in use.
Supports composite attestation across CPUs and GPUs for confidential AI workloads.
Enables deployment of existing applications within a secure TEE in minutes with no development or integration costs.

customer.target_customer: Enterprises and organizations that handle sensitive or regulated data, especially in highly regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, technology, and government.
buyers: Head of Data Security and Compliance
users: ML engineers running confidential AI workloads
problems: Sensitive data is exposed while being processed, even if it is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Organizations need to reduce insider, administrator, and cloud operator access to sensitive workloads.
Highly regulated organizations need stronger privacy, compliance, and data sovereignty controls.
Teams struggle to securely share or use sensitive data for AI, analytics, and innovation.
Organizations face operational complexity from fragmented confidential computing infrastructure and tooling.
use_cases: Protecting applications and data while in use in secure enclaves.
Securing AI training and inference so data and model weights are not exposed during processing.
Enabling secure healthcare data collaboration for machine learning and AI development.
Protecting sensitive financial and personally identifiable information while accelerating digital transformation.
Supporting secure data-driven innovation and cross-organizational data sharing.
desired_outcomes: Protect sensitive data, AI models, and secrets while they are in use.
Meet compliance and data sovereignty requirements such as GDPR, HIPAA, and similar regulations.
Reduce insider threat and privileged access risk.
Safely use data to innovate, collaborate, and build AI applications.
Simplify confidential computing operations and scale securely across environments.
existing_alternatives: Cloud-provider confidential computing infrastructure such as Azure Confidential Computing.
Relying only on encryption at rest and in transit without protecting data in use.

customer_stories: BeeKeeperAI used Fortanix Confidential Computing to accelerate healthcare AI and enable secure healthcare data collaboration.
Goldman Sachs is cited as a customer with Fortanix technology benefits seen first-hand, though the case study focuses on DSM rather than this product specifically.
company_expertise: Fortanix says it is a pioneer in Confidential Computing.
Fortanix cites 100+ security patents, 30+ papers in top conferences, and presentations at USENIX, CCC, and Blackhat.
Fortanix says it is a founding member of the Confidential Computing Consortium of the Linux Foundation.
product_evidence: Fortanix says it encrypts data in use across cloud applications, storage, and on-prem environments by isolating critical processes in a secure enclave.
Fortanix says Confidential Computing Manager provides a single control plane to configure, attest, and monitor confidential computing infrastructure across CPUs and GPUs.
Fortanix says keys are released only after cryptographic attestation and policy checks are met.
proprietary_insights_or_examples: Fortanix describes composite attestation across CPU and GPU to close security gaps between independently managed components.
Fortanix describes secure key release tied to verified firmware and software integrity.

writing_style: Frequently contrasts protection in-use with at-rest and in-transit
Uses technical security terminology such as attestation, secure enclave, and Trusted Execution Environments
